title: Universal injectivity into completion from fibre associated primes
statement: Let $R\to S$ be a homomorphism of Noetherian commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], let $I\subseteq R$ be an ideal, and let $P$ be a finite $S$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] flat over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Suppose that for every prime $\mathfrak q\subset S$, with contraction $\mathfrak p\subset R$, if $\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Ass}_S(P\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p))$ then $IS+\mathfrak q\ne S$. Here $\kappa(\mathfrak p)=\operatorname{Frac}(R/\mathfrak p)$ is the residue field [def-weil-residue-field], the tensor product has its canonical $S$-action, and associated primes are annihilators of elements as in [def-weil-pbc-annihilator-associated-primes]. Put $P^\wedge=\varprojlim_{n\ge1}P/I^nP$, the $R$-module of families $x_n\in P/I^nP$ compatible under the quotient maps, with componentwise operations; $I^nP$ is the submodule generated by $ap$ with $a\in I^n$ and $p\in P$. Then the canonical map $u:P\to P^\wedge$, $p\mapsto(p\bmod I^nP)_n$, is universally injective over $R$: for every $R$-module $Q$, $u\otimes_R1_Q:P\otimes_RQ\to P^\wedge\otimes_RQ$ is injective. Tensor products are [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product].
